const accessorSource = {
  set value(next: number) { console.log(next); },
  get other(): number { return 2; },
  get paired(): number { return 3; },
  set paired(next: number) { console.log(next); },
  set reverse(next: number) { console.log(next); },
  get reverse(): number { return 4; },
};
const spread = { ...accessorSource };
const { other, ...rest } = accessorSource;
const fromSpread: undefined = spread.value;
const fromRest: undefined = rest.value;
const pair: number = rest.paired;
const reversed: number = spread.reverse;
const asContract: { set value(next: number); get other(): number } = accessorSource;
const contractCopy: undefined = { ...asContract }.value;
const withConst: undefined = ({ ...accessorSource } as const).value;
const direct: number = accessorSource.value;
accessorSource.value = 9;
console.log(fromSpread, fromRest, pair, reversed, other, contractCopy, withConst, direct);
